tickets.title: Settings sidebar overlaps the invoice table

turns.text: Ticket T-1042 from Maya at Acme Corp: on the Settings page the left sidebar overlaps the invoice table at 125% zoom. Started after Tuesday's nav redesign. They use the compact sidebar.
Ack T-1042. Checking layout notes: Acme is on compact sidebar + dark mode. Asking Maya for viewport width and whether the overlap is over the invoice amount column or the whole table.
Maya: viewport 1440x900, browser Chrome 128, the nav sits on top of the first two invoice columns. Hard refresh did not help. Screenshot labeled sidebar-overlap-t1042.png.
Reproduced T-1042: nav width 240px, content offset still 12px, z-index 40 vs table 10. Likely missing left-padding after the compact-nav flag. Not billing-related.
Follow-up T-1042: Maya says after the CSS hotfix the overlap is gone at 100% but still clips the filter chips at 150% zoom. Please keep this ticket open.

facts.text: Acme Corp (support project) prefers compact sidebar and dark mode on Settings.

turns.text: Ticket T-1088 from Acme Finance: invoice INV-22091 for the September seat expansion appears twice on the billing PDF. They want the duplicate reversed, not a credit note.
T-1088 is billing, not the sidebar bug. Duplicate line is the same SKU (seat-expansion-sep). Routing to the invoice owner before touching Stripe.
Follow-up T-1088: Finance pinged again. They will not pay the duplicate. Ask the billing owner to confirm the reversal window before Friday close.

facts.text: PINNED-BILLING-OWNER-ADA: Acme invoice owner is Ada Chen in Finance (ada.chen@acme.example). Duplicate INV-22091 must be reversed, not credited.
